'''''Knife of Dreams book tour, West Chester, PA, 17 October 2005 - report by Githraine'''''

A user named Githraine submitted this report regarding recent answers received at a Jordan Book signing on the 17th of October:



If book 12 has to be 2000 pages, so be it (direct quote)

If there is a natural way to have Asmo's killer reveal him/her self, he/she will, if not RJ will announce the killer's ID when book 12 hits Paperback.
Working title for book 12: A Memory of Light

''Cuendillar'' chainmail is theoretically possible to create

RJ has a new idea that may result in several 'outrigger' novels in the WOT universe (despite previous denial he would ever do such a thing.)
